nodes.name: Ký hiệu vectơ
nodes.description: Vectơ được ký hiệu là AB (vectơ từ A đến B) hoặc a, b, x, y, ...

assignments.rationale: Both occurrences describe the notation for vectors, including the arrow notation for a vector from point A to B and the notation for generic vectors. The mathematical meaning is the same across grades 10 and 12. Grade difference is not a reason to split.
